actions.action: Lock abandoned sessions instead of deleting tickets.
actions.mechanism: A neutral screen hides selections; a visitor-chosen secret unlocks a locally retained cart without an account.
actions.implementation: Before selection, establish a masked recovery code. At inactivity lock, silence selection-related speech. Offer Resume or Start new; throttle guesses and expire carts.
actions.check: Offline for ten minutes, test three-minute reading pauses, successful recovery, and whether subsequent visitors can expose selections without the code.
actions.risk: Forgotten codes prevent recovery; visible codes compromise privacy.

actions.action: Separate long reading from private ticket review.
actions.mechanism: Public information screens contain no selections or personal details, allowing uninterrupted reading while the cart remains locked.
actions.implementation: Add Read at my pace before ticket choices. Keep generic information and screen-reader navigation available indefinitely; require the recovery code before revealing saved selections.
actions.check: Compare ordinary and reading modes: record reading interruptions, reconstruction attempts, and information exposed during staged visitor handoffs.
actions.risk: Extra unlocking adds friction; personalized summaries must never enter public screens.

actions.action: Retain tickets, but discard abandoned personal details.
actions.mechanism: Separate cart storage from short-lived personal-data entry limits what recovery can reveal and what abandonment leaves behind.
actions.implementation: Keep details out of cart checkpoints and logs. Clear them on locking or Start new; reset Back history and speech queues. Require explicit final purchase confirmation.
actions.check: Enter distinctive test details, abandon offline, then try Back, Resume, and screen-reader navigation. Verify details disappear, tickets recover, and no purchase submits.
actions.risk: Slow visitors may need to re-enter details after locking.
